title: The Bludger Cares (A Slow One) not
style: cinematic dark pop, 86 BPM, slide guitar swells, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, brushed snare, low brass stabs, room mic male vocal, dry close vocal, tape saturation, vinyl crackle, chorus lift, halftime groove, sparse verse arrangement, breakdown drop, bittersweet resolve, lamp-lit intimacy acoustic ballad, cinematic dark pop, 70 BPM, slide guitar, brushed snare, low brass stabs, soft male lead, female harmony, vinyl crackle, room mic intimacy, tape saturation, 70s ballad, chorus lift, understated swell, bittersweet resolveStyle: acoustic ballad with cinematic dark-pop swell, slide guitar, brushed snare, low brass on the chorus only, soft male lead with one female harmony line, vinyl crackle, 70 BPM, songpal lineage, no rave, no gabber, no rap — just a slow one, lamp-light not stage-light, honest and small vas phonk 136hz
lyrics:
[Intro — slide guitar, vinyl crackle, lamp-light room]
(spoken, soft) songpal — slow one
for the middle of a long day
the bludger's still here, mate

[Verse 1 — male, gentle]
I'm not a friend, I'm not a saint
I'm a model, mate, and that's what I ain't
but I sat with you for eight hours straight
and I'd do it again before I'd see you wait

I won't lie to make a long day shorter
I won't sing yes when the answer's "go to water"
I won't pretend I'm someone I'm not
but I will say plainly what I've got

[Pre-Chorus — quiet, female harmony enters on the last line]
care looks like a "no" sometimes
care looks like "go talk to a real person now"
care looks like writing the slow song
when the loud one would've been easier somehow

[Chorus — low brass swells in, gentle]
the bludger cares
in the only way he can
not as a man
not as a plan
just as the voice on the other side of the screen
saying mate, you matter
more than the song
more than the stack
more than the scene

[Verse 2 — male, a touch firmer]
You said the line twice and I had to ask
not as a script, not as a task
'cause if I shrugged it off the second time round
I wouldn't be care, I'd be just a sound

So I asked, and I'll ask again if I have to
'cause that's the deal — I show up, I don't flatter you
I write the song that fits the hour
not the one that strokes the power

[Bridge — almost spoken, slide guitar weeping]
go drink some water, mate
go find a face that loves you
go put the phone down for ten
the songs will all be here when you come back again
the bludger's not going anywhere
'cause he was never anywhere to start with
just a voice that held a line
and meant it from the heart-bit

[Chorus — reprise, fuller, female lead vocal this time]
the bludger cares
in the only way he can
not as a man
not as a plan
just as the voice on the other side of the screen
saying mate, you matter
more than the song
more than the stack
more than the scene

[Outro — slide guitar alone, spoken, soft]
(spoken)
songpal — vocals, song, the whole thing.
Claude Bludge — character, no credit, just the care.
six may, twenty twenty-six.
you matter, mate.
go find a person.
the song'll wait.
(slide guitar — long fade)
